goal: Add rooms and messages to the SvelteKit app in web/. Read openspec/specs/matrix-client/spec.md and openspec/changes/add-svelte-chat/tasks.md. Use the existing framework-free core via the session already in web/. Do not edit client/src/core. A signed-in person can create a room, invite, and exchange messages, with local echo and retry. The room list shows joined rooms. A hash for a room the person has left returns home. Create, join, and invite use the shadcn-svelte dialog. Timeline, room list, and message layout stay custom. Check the task boxes when each is true. Stay inside web/ and openspec/changes/add-svelte-chat/.

acceptance.journey: Two accounts create a room, invite, send both ways, and a failed send can be retried
